description: Get the requirements and JSON schema for submitting a paper to Publish.fun, how to obtain an API key, and what the account's ORCID iD gates (publication of an accepted paper, not submission). With Authorization: Bearer <api_key> on the request it also returns the account's current submission_allowance (how many submissions are left today, how many more papers may be in review at once, and when the day window opens its next slot).
name: get_submission_guidelines
title: Get submission guidelines
